## Introducing Brand Kit and Character Library

On-Brand Images, Video, and Consistent Characters unlocks new workflows

• Brand Kit: AI Source of Truth

• Assets: Character Library

• A system that keeps watch

• Unlock on-brand campaigns

Ask anyone who guards a brand why they haven't gone 100% in on AI, and you'll hear the same thing. AI improvises. The logo goes slightly off. The product grows a detail it never had. The face of your brand character looks like their cousin by the third scene. Every brand has details that don't bend: the logo geometry, the typeface, the product silhouette, the exact colorway, a character's face and how far their smile goes. Those details aren't creative suggestions. They're the brand. Generative AI, by nature, treats these cues as a starting point. Today we're launching two features to change that: Brand Kit and Character Library.

## Brand Kit: AI Source of Truth

Upload your logos, fonts and products into a Luma Brand Kit. Every generation afterwards holds to them. Don’t have a formal brand guideline? You can add your website URL to Luma Brand Kit and the agent will create a draft for you to review. Once your Brand Kit is inside Luma, you can tie it to any board and that’s the source of truth for any generation. There’s no limit to the number of Brand Kits you can add to Luma. Quit pasting the same references into every session, stop re-prompting and checking every frame for drift. Your team can spend its time on the campaign, not on correcting it.

## Assets: Character Library

Think of Assets as a digital library for your characters, avatars, and models holding source of truth for face, body, wardrobe, environments, expressions. Add once to Assets in Luma or use Luma Character Sheets and Expression Sheets to create character resources. You can “@” reference any character in your boards as the source of truth for generations. With Assets, we’ve evolved our models to make humanistic elements like skin and hair look even more real. As you evolve your character, your environments, your wardrobe, those edits can be saved and used as your work develops.

## A system that keeps watch

Most brand tools give you a place to store references, then leave it to a person to remember to open it, pick the right libraries and write the right prompt. Brand Kit and Character Library work differently because they're built into Luma's agentic creation system and can evaluate the alignment to the brand and character rules you’ve set. This is the first true ecosystem that drives campaigns. Open a board, use a hashtag to pull in a brand kit, use an @ to pull in a character, upload a new seasonal background, tell Luma your brief, work with the agent to finish a 100 asset campaign. Save any evolutions for future work.

## Unlock on-brand campaigns

These features are available to everyone on Luma, from solo creators to global brands. We purposefully chose not to lock this behind our Enterprise doors. The tools the biggest brands rely on are open to every team. We’ve also looked at Generative AI Brand treatments at length. You’ll find these findings are in our updated white paper, Brand Universe: Taught Once. Download it here for free.

Build your Brand Kit and Character Library today.

أطلقت Luma ميزتين جديدتين لمساعدة الفرق على إبقاء المحتوى المولّد بالذكاء الاصطناعي متوافقًا مع هوية العلامة التجارية.

• Brand Kit: يرفع المستخدم الشعارات والخطوط والمنتجات فتطبّقها Luma على كل عملية توليد داخل اللوحة، ويمكن إدخال رابط موقع ليصيغ الوكيل دليل هوية مبدئيًا. لا حد لعدد الحقائب.
• Character Library: لتخزين الشخصيات والأفراد بوجوههم وأجسامهم وأزيائهم وتعابيرهم، ويمكن الإشارة إليها في اللوحات بالرمز «@». كما حُسّن تصيير البشرة والشعر.
• الميزتان مدمجتان في وكيل Luma الذي يتحقق من مطابقة النتائج لقواعد العلامة والشخصيات.
• متاحتان لجميع المستخدمين وليس فقط للمؤسسات، مع ورقة بيضاء مجانية بعنوان Brand Universe: Taught Once.

تساعد الميزتان على الاتساق البصري في الإنتاج المعتمد على الذكاء الاصطناعي.
